audit_items.proof_trace: Two independent staleness guards enforce the property. At ingest, `assert_price_not_stale` (L81-89) enforces `price_updated_time >= now - 30s` and `price_updated_time <= now`, preventing stale Pyth data from being stored. At read time, `check_price` (user.move:61-69) enforces `clock.timestamp_ms() - last_updated * 1000 <= price_delay_tolerance_ms` (default 5000ms) on every price consumption; all protocol consumer paths (`get_price`, `get_spot_price`, `get_price_with_check`) unconditionally call `check_price` — verified across borrow, withdraw, liquidation, and ADL paths in market.move.
